conditions: The Twin Grakatas recipe consumes two separate Grakatas, so build and own two before starting its blueprint.

groups.activity: build both Grakatas, then Twin Grakatas

rows.label: Grakata
rows.note: 25,000 cr, 2 Neurodes, 400 Alloy Plate, 900 Salvage, 100 Polymer Bundle — build twice

conditions: Level one Grakata to 30 before it goes into the recipe — Mastery is earned once per item type, so the second copy needs no levelling.
The recipe needs two Grakata weapon slots free while building; the Twin build consumes both and returns one weapon, freeing a slot.
If you already own a Prisma Grakata, the Foundry lists it as an eligible ingredient but won't let you select it — use the plain Grakata.
bonuses: Alloy Plate, Salvage and Polymer Bundle are common drops you'll already have; only Neurodes is worth watching for.
